# K-House

> K-House is a flexible live jazz group in Exeter, Devon, playing standards, adaptations, and originals for venues, private events, jam sessions, dinners, and celebrations.

By David Reinstein (https://www.davidreinstein.org/). More projects: https://projects.davidreinstein.org/

## About the band

- A modular jazz group based in Exeter, Devon (South West UK): lineups of 3 to 7 players to suit the room, budget and occasion.
- Players include Eugenio Sabatino (drums), Dan Knibb (guitar), David Reinstein (tuba, trombone, flugelhorn), Olwen Payne (trumpet) and Matt Aaronson (gypsy guitar), with vocalists, percussion and other guests by arrangement.
- Repertoire: jazz standards, swing, ballads, bebop, Brazilian and Latin tunes, blues, modern jazz, and some originals and adaptations.
- Available for venue gigs, jam sessions (as house band), dinners, private events and community events. Easy indoor or outdoor setup, acoustic-friendly. Rates on a sliding scale.
- Booking and enquiries: daaronr@gmail.com
